missing_in_a: GET /endpoints route discovery/listing of declared resources
missing_in_b: max request body size limit with 413
concurrent-connection cap with explicit 503 admission behavior
differentiated startup exit codes per config failure mode
reasons: Both cover core topic publish/read and service bridging with testable ACs. A defines a closed-world envelope (size/conn/route limits, exit-code taxonomy, error-code vocabulary, timeout abandonment, strict codec rules) and a spec that pre-answers concurrency, admission-control, and race-condition questions, with tight requirements–spec traceability. B is cleaner and adds ops endpoints, but leaves body size, connection caps, and mapping edge cases open. A wins on implementability, edge completeness, and consistency despite verbose process metadata.
